items.name: Alarm Clock
items.description: Use to set an alarm sound. Can also be used as a timer-based trigger when connected to other interactive parts. Comes with selectable alarm sounds.

items.name: Beacon

items.name: Crystalium

items.description: Use the Dressbot to make new clothes for your Mechanic. Just add your garment boxes and the right amount of cotton. You can also customise your look by using the blue wardrobe.

items.name: Drill
items.description: Use the Drill to mine square rocks for stone and metal. Put it on a bearing that is connected to a engine and drive it in to a square rock.

items.description: Makes bearings turn left and right. Can be connected to an engine to control the direction of travel. Can also be connected to triggers that can be activated from the saddle. Lvl 5 Driver's Saddle unlocks steering settings by pressing (E) on connected bearings with the Connect Tool.

items.name: Electric Engine Level 1

items.name: Fire Extinguisher
